alejandra: Quick PR incoming to add micro-snippets for streaming migration (SDK>=1.12). Need tiny examples for Python/TS/Go: iterator, callback shim, and a retry note.

vince: Keep them copy/paste ready (<=6 lines). For TS use `for await (const p of client.stream(...))` then a one-liner adapter that returns a cancel function.

jia: Python: `async for chunk in client.stream(...)` + `def attach(on_message): asyncio.create_task(_pump(on_message))` shim. Add comment: 'do retries outside the shim'.

alejandra: Go snippet: `for { msg, err := stream.Recv(); if err!=nil { break } handler(msg.Text) }` and `WrapStream(ctx, handler)` that spawns a goroutine and honors context cancel.

vince: Also add a short blurb about pagination tokens: adapters must surface continuation tokens to callers, don't swallow them.

ci-bot: Branch created: docs/stream-adapters. Running docs-lint.

alejandra: Pushed draft PR with the three snippets under docs/snippets/streaming-adapters/. PR link: https://git.example/redwood/docs/pull/99 (WIP).

jia: Renamed `on_data` -> `on_message` in all examples and added SDK version callout.

vince: LGTM. Ping me for final review after CI.

ci-bot: Lint passed. Merging allowed when reviewers approve.

alejandra: Merged. Added a release notes line linking the snippets and a short changelog note about retry semantics. Closing thread.
